issue: The car chip pushed the lock line and the title «Ապահովագրությունը ժամկետանց է» off the right edge, and the only primary «Վերբեռնել ապահովագրությունը» was cut mid-word — the one instruction on the screen could not be read.
fix: Hide the car chip in this state, let the title wrap to two lines, shorten the primary to «Վերբեռնել նորը» (the block above already names the document).

issue: With an offer still ringing in the background the sheet's one primary was «Դադարեցնել» and the offer card carried no clock, so the driver had to choose between two equally weighted things with no sense of urgency.
fix: The primary morphs to «Բացել պատվերը» while the offer runs (Pause leaves the bottom slot), and the card shows the seconds left in amber beside the distance.

issue: The rider paid in the app, but the biggest thing on the screen was «1 100 ֏» — on every other done screen the hero is the amount to collect, so a glance reads «take 1 100 cash».
fix: No figure hero, as on company-done: the fare moves into the caption line and the «paid in the app · take nothing» card is the first thing read.

issue: The T−25 heads-up carried the 76px «Ճանապարհին եմ» at the top of the glass — the hardest reach one-handed, on a path taken while driving.
fix: The heads-up keeps what and when; the start moves to the bottom of the sheet, the same place as driver-home-states held.

issue: At speed the remaining time to the drop is a 13px eyebrow («4 րոպե · 2,9 կմ · 9:51») while the fare beside the address is 22px — the less actionable number is the louder one.
fix: Give the minutes-to-drop the right-hand hero slot (as «4 րոպե» on assigned) and fold the fare into the eyebrow; same in enroute and company-inprogress.
note: Inverted: minutes to the drop are the 40/48 hero on the right (assigned's pattern); distance, clock and fare fold into the 13px eyebrow. Applied to inprogress, paychanged, destchanged, company-inprogress (no fare) and enroute (the pickup's minutes).

issue: Four reason chips plus three stacked actions of very different weight («Չեղարկել», «Վերադարձնել», «Հետ») on one sheet; the reasons apply only to Cancel but are read first.
fix: Lead with the two outcomes; show the reason chips only after «Չեղարկել» is chosen, keep «Հետ» as the bottom thumb-zone default.
note: State «cancel» now leads with the two outcomes (Cancel, Give back) and a text «Հետ»; the reasons live on the new state «cancel-reason», reached only after Cancel, where tapping a reason cancels (none preselected). Return/Back are the quieter controls.

issue: Declining costs two taps (chip, then a reason) inside a 12 s window; a driver who runs out the clock on the reason sheet risks being counted as a missed offer (→ Away).
fix: Spec that an expiry while the reason sheet is open records a decline without reason, never a miss; say so in the sheet's caption.
note: Won't fix — owner confirmed 2026-10-16: the required reason stays (rule of 2026-10-12). One-tap decline with an optional reason was proposed and declined.

issue: The end of every ride closes on trip facts (km, minutes, wait) — data nobody acts on — instead of the driver's progress for the day.
fix: Replace the facts row with «Այսօր · 2 պատվեր · 2 300 ֏» (same on partner-home ridedone with the wallet after the fee).
note: Done cards close on «Այսօր · 2 պատվեր · 2 300 ֏» (hairline, 22px values) with the trip facts demoted to one 12px line above it. No fare hero for app-paid rides kept. No daily goal exists in the product, so no goal bar. Partner-home ridedone is another page and was not touched (it has no trip-facts row; the wallet line is already its closing fact).

issue: The shift summary is complete but flat: total, split bar, hourly bars, then «Ավարտել հերթափոխը» — no comparison that makes the day feel finished (vs yesterday or the week's average).
fix: Add one comparison line under the total (e.g. «+1 400 ֏ երեկվանից») and keep the rest.
note: One comparison line under the total, «+1 400 ֏ երեկվանից», ok-green with a trend icon; the rest unchanged.

issue: The Cash / NFC · POS switch sits between the hero and «Պատրաստ եմ»; a stray tap on NFC turns the primary into a disabled «Սպասում ենք վճարմանը…».
fix: Add 8px more separation above the primary and require the switch to be released on the segment (no swipe-through), or move the facts row between switch and primary.
note: The facts row is now a single caption and the day-progress row sits between the switch and «Պատրաստ եմ», giving 40px+ of separation. The release-on-segment rule is an interaction spec for the app and is not drawable in a static mock.

issue: The hero stays at 1 122 ֏ while the cash fallback (1 100 ֏) is a 13px caption; correct while NFC is selected, but the fallback amount is easy to miss.
fix: Keep as is; when the switch moves to Cash the hero must re-render to 1 100 ֏ (state it in the spec note).
note: Kept as is; marked in driver-ride.html: moving the switch to Cash re-renders the hero to 1 100 ֏ (NFC · POS keeps 1 122 ֏).

issue: The chat button with an unread badge sits beside Call on the approach — the badge invites reading while moving.
fix: Suppress the badge count while the car is moving (dot only) and open chat to quick replies only above walking speed.
note: Enroute: the unread mark is a 14px dot with no count; the chat/call tools moved below the head as a labelled row. Quick-replies-only while moving was already the chat state's rule.

issue: Three chips (Eco City, Ֆիքսված, Կանխիկ) wrap to two lines under the fare, pushing the pickup line down by a row on the one screen that must read in 2 s.
fix: Merge tier + fixed into one chip («Eco City · ֆիքսված») so the chips stay on one line.
note: Merged into one chip «Eco City · ֆիքսված» (lock icon) on preorder-now and preorder-any; the chips stay on one line.

issue: The green «Սկսել» chip inside the startable card looks like its own button but the whole card is the target (it opens details).
fix: Render it as a status tag (no button shape), or make it the real 48px start with the card opening details.
note: Now a status tag (no fill, no pill, circle-check icon, «Կարելի է սկսել»); the whole card stays the single target.

issue: «Ջնջել հաշիվը» is the full-width row directly under «Դուրս գալ» — adjacent rows of equal size for a reversible and an irreversible action.
fix: Move delete into Help/legal or separate it with a section gap; it already leads to a confirm, so low.
note: «Ջնջել հաշիվը» left the main list (under «Դուրս գալ» at equal size) and sits in its own «Հաշիվ» group at the bottom of Help and legal, a section apart. It still leads to the confirm.

issue: Past-ride routes are ellipsised («Զվարթնոց → Բաղրամյան պող. 24…»), cutting the destination — the part a driver uses to recognise the ride.
fix: Let the route wrap to two lines or drop the street number before the place name.
note: The route wraps to two lines instead of an ellipsis (data-truncate removed).

issue: A street pickup cannot continue without a destination, though a passenger in the car may only say «straight on, I'll tell you».
fix: Allow Continue without «Ուր» on a metered (non-fixed) tariff; the fare line then reads «ըստ հաշվիչի».
note: A street pickup continues with no destination: «Շարունակել» is enabled, the tariff step reads «ըստ հաշվիչի», and the new ready-meter state shows «Ուղղությունը՝ ճանապարհին» and a metered fare. New states: meter, ready-meter.

issue: The heads-up ring caption «րոպե» overlaps the ring by 1px and the title is flagged as ellipsised at 390px (pre-existing, not from this audit's change).
fix: Give the ring inner text 2px more room or drop the caption to 10px.
note: Ring value/unit boxes get a 2px gap (driver.css .dring .in) and the heads-up title wraps instead of ellipsising; this also fixed the same 1px overlap on the list cards' rings.
